cookies.aboutDescription: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our service.
cookies.learnMore: Learn more in our Privacy Policy
cookies.essentialDesc: These cookies are necessary for the Netflix service to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility.
cookies.analyticsDesc: These cookies help us understand how you use the Netflix service by collecting and reporting information anonymously. This helps us improve our service.
cookies.personalizationDesc: These cookies allow us to remember your preferences and provide enhanced, personalized features.
cookies.advertisingDesc: These cookies are used to deliver relevant advertisements to you and limit the number of times you see an advertisement.

corporate.overviewContent: Netflix, Inc. is an American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming service. The company primarily distributes original and acquired films and television shows from various genres.
corporate.globalPresenceContent: Netflix is available in over 190 countries worldwide, with regional headquarters in Los Gatos (USA), Amsterdam (EMEA), Singapore (APAC), and São Paulo (Latin America).
corporate.leadershipContent: Led by co-founder and CEO Ted Sarandos and co-CEO Greg Peters, Netflix's leadership team brings decades of experience in technology, entertainment, and global business operations.
corporate.awardsContent: Netflix has won numerous Emmy Awards, Golden Globes, and Academy Awards for its original content, making it one of the most awarded streaming platforms in the world.

speedTest.congestionDesc: During peak hours, network congestion can affect your streaming quality. Try watching during off-peak times for better performance.
speedTest.devicePerformanceDesc: Older devices may not support the latest streaming technologies. Consider updating your device or using a compatible streaming device.
speedTest.downloadSpeedDesc: Run a speed test to check your current internet speed. If it's below the recommended levels, contact your internet service provider.
speedTest.testConnectionDesc: Click the button below to test your current internet speed
speedTest.tip1: Connect your device directly to your router using an Ethernet cable
speedTest.tip2: Close other applications that may be using bandwidth
speedTest.tip3: Reduce the number of devices connected to your network
speedTest.tip4: Move closer to your Wi-Fi router or use a Wi-Fi extender
speedTest.tip5: Upgrade your internet plan if speeds are consistently low
